monster_night_panther_idle.png.prompt:
The creature: a large sleek BLACK PANTHER with glowing purple slash markings on its fur, pale purple eyes, a worn leather collar with a small silver bell. Keep the EXACT same creature design as the reference image - same fur colour, same purple markings, same collar and bell, same face. ONLY THE POSE CHANGES.

Pose: standing still and watching, head slightly lowered, ears back, eyes fixed on the viewer. Calm and menacing - it has not moved yet.
**IT MUST BE STANDING ON ALL FOUR PAWS, AND ALL FOUR PAWS MUST BE AT THE SAME LEVEL,
RIGHT ON THE BOTTOM EDGE OF THE PICTURE.** This is the whole point of redrawing it.
The reference shows it crouched low with its hindquarters raised - **do not copy that**.
In the reference the paws sit at wildly different heights, so it reads as hovering in mid-air
instead of standing in the room. Straighten the legs, drop the hips, and put all four paws
down in a row along the bottom, the way a big cat stands when it is simply watching you.
The belly line should be roughly level, not a steep diagonal.

Full body, facing LEFT. Fill the frame.
Only ONE creature in the picture.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the creature.
Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as monster_night_panther_idle.png in the current directory and report the path.
